g.text: P136 — Whole-job cost and official outcome
All six conditions: one known CSV task × two fixed seeds × three modes. Failed work and paid actor/focus included.
Fixed development gate: False. Negative differences mean fewer tokens, not automatically better quality.
Hatching = known subtotal plus unmeasured usage; × = usage unmeasured. No condition is omitted. Cached input is not subtracted.
Common-success costs exclude quality gains, losses and both-failed pairs; these outcomes remain in the all-pair comparison.
Comparison-table 'unmeasured' also includes conservative fixed-gate null aggregates with some known components.
One known task and two seeds do not establish general quality preservation or technical novelty.
